title: When the Hollow Sings Again
author: Juniper Vane
blurb: Mirabel Lockridge, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
